name: Kuribayashi Musashi
source:
A detective who died in the line of duty more than ten years ago. He founded and managed the "Youth Division," a department focused on recruiting talented young individuals to the police force. Ikuta, Strichoss, Ruka and Sousuke were his mentees.

[spoiler] He was asked by Superintendent General Niigaki to infiltrate the Cult, but got involved in a terrorist attack and was killed by Ruka.

He was a keeper with ability of syncing consciousness with people. When Ruka killed him, a part of his consciouness synced with Ruka's, creating bizarre dreams in which he and Ruka talk about things happened in real life. [/spoiler]

A detective who died in the line of duty more than ten years ago. He founded and managed the "Youth Division," a department focused on recruiting talented young individuals to the police force. Ikuta, Strichoss, Ruka and Sousuke were his mentees.

[spoiler] He was asked by Superintendent General Niigaki to infiltrate the Cult, but got involved in a terrorist attack and was killed by Ruka.

He was a keeper with ability of syncing consciousness with people. When Ruka killed him, a part of his consciouness synced with Ruka's, creating bizarre dreams in which he and Ruka talk about things happened in real life. [/spoiler]
